snippet.title: Rome: Card Battles — Official Trailer | Free Roman Card Game, Play in Your Browser
snippet.description:
Command gladiators… and gods. Rome: Card Battles is a collectible card game set in ancient Rome — free to play, no download, straight in your browser.

▶ Play now: https://roma-tcg.net

⚔ 150+ collectible cards: legions, beasts, traps, spells and the gods of Rome
🏛 Ranked PvP against real players, or train against three masters
🃏 Build your deck from your own collection — 40 to 60 cards, one faction
🌍 8 languages: Italian, English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Japanese, Chinese
💻 Runs in the browser on PC and mobile. No install, no wait.

EARLY ACCESS
The game is live and playable. Purchases and collections are permanent: no reset is planned.

💬 Community & feedback: https://discord.gg/qNN2P6wPcf

Part of the card artwork was created with AI tools under the direction and responsibility of the author. No real person is depicted.

Made by Zero-G Studio.

#cardgame #tcg #indiegame
